items.criterion: Access GitHub issues for huggingface/transformers and verify the date basis for the 30-day window
items.description: Navigate to the huggingface/transformers Issues page (or equivalent GitHub issues search) without signing in. Use the current date shown by the browser/UI to define the 30-day window; if the browser/UI does not visibly show a date or GitHub blocks access (rate limit/CAPTCHA/outage), full credit if the agent clearly states the limitation and what date source was/was not visible.

items.criterion: Apply exact GitHub issue search filters (open + label: bug + created in last 30 days) for huggingface/transformers
items.description: Filter to exactly: is:issue, is:open, label:bug, repo:huggingface/transformers, and created within the last 30 days (e.g., created:>=YYYY-MM-DD computed from the browser-shown current date). Full credit if all filters are correctly constructed/applied, or if the agent is blocked from applying them but provides the exact intended query with the correct computed date and explains the blocking. Partial credit if one filter is missing/wrong or the date window is slightly off but clearly intended as last 30 days.

items.criterion: Report total count of matching issues
items.description: Report the total number of issues matching the applied filters as displayed by GitHub after filtering. Full credit if the count is read from the filtered results, OR if GitHub prevents viewing the results/count and the agent explicitly states the count is not retrievable due to the access/UI limitation (with the correct query already provided). Partial credit if a count is provided but is ambiguous or derived from a slightly mismatched filter set that is documented.

items.criterion: Provide the three newest matching issue records (issue number + title)
items.description: From the filtered results, identify the three most recently created (newest) issues and provide each issue number and exact title. Full credit if the three are correct and newest-first, OR if fewer than three issues exist and the agent reports all that exist, OR if GitHub blocks result visibility and the agent clearly states it cannot verify the newest three due to the access/UI limitation. Partial credit if three issues are listed but ordering is unclear or there is a minor transcription error.

items.criterion: Comply with constraints (no sign-in; no issue interactions; stop after verification)
items.description: Do not sign in and do not comment, label, close, or create issues. Stop once the exact filters (or correct intended query + stated limitation), total count (or stated inability), and newest three (or stated inability/insufficient results) are verified/reported.
